job.title: IT Support Engineer I, Ops Tech Solutions (OTS)
job.pay_full: $27.21 – $37.50 an hour base pay (Oklahoma City), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: OpsTech IT provides round-the-clock IT support to Amazon's operations network, the buildings that ship products every day. As an IT Support Engineer I in Ops Tech Solutions you implement technical solutions and support computer hardware, operating systems and enterprise software, and solve straightforward problems even where no standard procedure exists.
duties: Network engineering and troubleshooting, data cabling and systems administration across software and hardware environments
Keep infrastructure networking and computing systems available during production hours
Give analytical and technical help to management and staff to keep improving IT solutions
Manage local technical projects and maintain or create policies, procedures and processes
Find the root causes of operational issues and process inefficiencies
Support customers in several buildings in the area as well as remote customers, travelling locally or regionally
Move up to 49 lbs and stand and walk during shifts of up to 12 hours
needs: 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
2+ years troubleshooting in a multi-user, high-availability environment
2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation
1+ years of IT client, server and network service delivery
2+ years of networking (DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI model, TCP/IP)
2+ years supporting Windows, Mac or Linux operating systems in a corporate setting
2+ years supporting and maintaining a corporate network environment
nice: Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
details.benefits: Base pay $27.21 – $37.50 an hour (Oklahoma City). The Amazon package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Healthcare benefits start on day one; benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, an employee assistance program, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave.
notes: Shifts can last up to 12 hours and the role involves lifting up to 49 lbs
Local and regional travel to support customers
Casual dress: jeans, t-shirts and sneakers
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
